sn2.19:1.1: Rājagaha nidānam || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Uttaro devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.19:2.1: Upanīyati jīvitam appam āyu || jarūpanītassa na santi tāṇā || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno || puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti || ||
